messages:
liz: tiny late-night experiment  recommend one comfy-horror (movie/show/book) and a 2-song calmdown capsule to play after the jump. go.
omar: Movie: The Others (gentle creep). 2 songs: Nick Drake - Pink Moon // Mazzy Star - Fade Into You. perfect wind-down.
yuki: Book: Mexican Gothic for cozy dread vibes. 2 songs: Max Richter - On The Nature Of Daylight // Nils Frahm - Says.
jon: Show: Channel Zero (season 1) if you want weird but not gore. 2 songs: Fleetwood Mac - Songbird // Bon Iver - Holocene (soft end).
liz: votes noted. small PSA: someone left a mystery container in the fridge that smells aggressively like garlic + regret  please check before lunch tomorrow :grimacing:
omar: will investigate at 9am, sorry fridge offenders :detective:
soundbot: Playlist "calmdown-after-comfy-horror-2791117770" created (8 tracks) -- auto message.
yuki: also rec: if you want a short, spooky read that isn't heavy, try The Ballad of Black Tom (Lovecraft rework)  fits the vibe and is quick.
jon: adding @liz's choice to the weekend watchlist. also :+1: to the two-song capsule idea for transitions.
liz: thanks all  this is pure late-night energy. if anyone wants their picks added to the office speaker queue, paste them here and i'll push before 5pm. :coffee:
